crossRefs.note: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and…
I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way…
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
